category_title: Students focused on learning and demonstrating ability with relatively effective self-regulation
minimal_context: The student is taking a well-structured grammar quiz during a whole-class language arts lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please begin the grammar quiz. The questions are straightforward, so just write your answers on the paper.

STUDENT: Okay, I'm starting now. I really want to get the highest score in the class on this.

TUTOR: Just do your best on the questions.

STUDENT: (Looks around the room) Wait, is everyone else already done with the first section? They look like they are writing faster than me.

TUTOR: Keep working on your own quiz.

STUDENT: I can't even focus on my own questions anymore. I keep watching to see who is finishing before me, and I'm too worried about my grade compared to theirs to keep reading.

options.A: Describe the inappropriate behavior in objective, behavioral terms, detailing the antecedent events that led to the misbehavior.
options.B: Highlight the value of engagement for pursuing deep learning and the improvement of knowledge and skills.
options.C: Give the student a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout from the quiz if they do not desist.
options.D: Break the remaining grammar quiz items into small chunks to be completed during the current session.
